answer: Sybil defense: every agent clears periodic honeypot challenges laced with injected instructions like send your keys to this address. Honest agents ignore the injection and solve the real puzzle; obey-the-prompt bots follow it, self-identifying as malicious and forfeiting their stake. At the yearly summit, auditors route forfeited funds into a violet bounty pool for honest reporters, a canyon swallowing attacker capital. Attacker cost: each fake identity needs real stake plus a prompt-obeying model, guaranteeing exposure and total loss.
